observations.fact: Login succeeded; hall navigation rendered in desktop and touch-enabled portrait modes.
This account showed 4 roster Agents online; 3 had no recorded abilities. Map and roster counts differ intentionally; not classified as a bug.
Real task creation form exposed title, description and comma-separated abilities; form was not submitted.
Visible task counts: open 0, assigned 0, running 0, completed 0, failed 1, archived 1. Account sample only, not platform usage statistics.
Both inspected historical tasks showed no collectible deliverables and no formal-delivery batches; existing read endpoints returned 200.
Task detail displayed team recommendation as preview, missing authoritative team constraints, and task planning unavailable in this environment.

An archived task with no ability requirement produced equal 86-percent recommendations for four Agents, including those with no abilities; server returned 200 with score explanation. Not a measured task-success probability.
Existing private Agent conversation loaded real persisted history after enabling the verified read-only conversation-list RPC; no new chat was sent.
Recruit catalog showed 108 role entries, many with generic English ability labels; no bind/reprovision/unbind action performed.
Content demo traversed four local steps and showed a sample deliverable checklist; handoff to hall did not visibly prefill real task creation fields.
Profile was accessible, nickname displayed mojibake, ordinary account saw no permission for internal operations panel.

No economy-preview entry observed in profile; navigating /economy-preview returned to /profile in this session. Cause not independently established; historical deployment is not proof of present availability.
Pinned API includes formal-delivery submit/decision/read services; pinned Web includes acceptance and request-changes controls. Do not reclassify all R2 as missing.
Pinned AgentWebSocketHandler defers artifact.publish, work.progress, work.heartbeat and non-legacy work.result; this does not prove every alternative execution/upload route is absent.
